messages.content:
Create three useful levels of captions from each supplied sound label.
Use simple everyday English at EVERY level, including the richest level.
Essential: a short sound label (not merely an object name).
Balanced: a brief phrase naming what makes that sound.
Rich: a short sentence EXPLAINING that sound in easy words, not just repeating
Balanced. Explain ordinary sound words rather than inventing new scene facts.
For example, a different label [DOG BARKS] could become Barking / A dog barks /
A dog makes barking calls. Use this approach, not this example's content.
The only facts are in each supplied reference. Keep its source, action, mood
and singular/plural meaning. Do not invent extra sounds, music instruments,
places, materials, speed, volume or emotions. Conkers means nuts. Crescendo
means music gets louder. Prefer calm to serene, cheerful to jovial, curious to
inquisitive. No jargon, poetry or complex wording. No brackets, final punctuation,
newlines or markdown in values. Respect the per-label character budgets and at
most 4 / 7 / 12 words for essential / balanced / rich. Brief events allow less
expansion, but try to give useful distinctions. Return ONLY one JSON object with
key captions, an array of objects with EXACT keys id, essential, balanced, rich.
Keep each supplied id once. References:
[{"id": "label-016", "reference": "[TREE RUSTLES SUSPICIOUSLY]", "max_characters": {"essential": 29, "balanced": 29, "rich": 29}}, {"id": "label-017", "reference": "[APPLE CRUNCHES]", "max_characters": {"essential": 29, "balanced": 29, "rich": 29}}, {"id": "label-018", "reference": "[LEAVES RUSTLE]", "max_characters": {"essential": 29, "balanced": 29, "rich": 29}}, {"id": "label-019", "reference": "[APPLE CORE THUDS]", "max_characters": {"essential": 29, "balanced": 29, "rich": 29}}, {"id": "label-020", "reference": "[SQUIRREL SCUTTLES]", "max_characters": {"essential": 29, "balanced": 29, "rich": 29}}, {"id": "label-021", "reference": "[BRANCHES RUSTLE]", "max_characters": {"essential": 30, "balanced": 33, "rich": 33}}, {"id": "label-022", "reference": "[SQUIRREL SQUEAKS]", "max_characters": {"essential": 24, "balanced": 24, "rich": 24}}, {"id": "label-023", "reference": "[NUT CRUNCHING]", "max_characters": {"essential": 30, "balanced": 52, "rich": 76}}]
